description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMatcherProcessor' implementing 'MatcherProcessorInterface' within the Goteo project. It provides core functionality for processing matchers, including user amount calculations, investment list generation, and event listener configurations, specifically for the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: AbstractMatcherProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing core matching processing functionalities, including user amount distribution, investment creation, and event listener setup within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a simplified class name identifier for the processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the processor.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the given matcher corresponds to this processor.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the processor if the matcher is valid for it.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of variable labels (empty by default).

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Retrieves variables, combining default and custom matcher variables.

methods.name: getUserAmounts
methods.description: Calculates and returns how to distribute a total amount among users based on their pools.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Generates a list of investment objects based on the matching process.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Sets the matcher object for processing.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the project context, throws exception if not set.

methods.name: getAppEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default application event listeners for this processor.

methods.name: getConsoleEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default console event listeners for this processor.
